recommendations.summary: Aspirin is recommended for all patients without contraindications.
recommendations.details: Initial oral loading dose (LD) 150–300 mg (or 75–250 mg i.v.) and a maintenance dose (MD) of 75–100 mg o.d. for long-term treatment.

recommendations.summary: P2Y12 receptor inhibitor recommended in addition to aspirin for ACS patients.
recommendations.details: Given as an initial oral LD followed by an MD for 12 months unless there is high bleeding risk.

recommendations.summary: Proton pump inhibitor recommended with dual antiplatelet therapy for high GI bleeding risk.
recommendations.details: A PPI in combination with dual antiplatelet therapy is recommended in patients at high risk of gastrointestinal bleeding.

Associated Conditions: antiplatelet therapy/response to P2Y12 receptor inhibitors
genes.context: Text states 'a P2Y12 receptor inhibitor is recommended in addition to aspirin' for all ACS patients, given as an initial oral LD followed by an MD for 12 months.
